purpose: Review a finite bank loan-classification migration, non-performing exposure, provisioning, write-off, transfer, recovery and forbearance lifecycle domain before source rows, values, factor values, comparators, security prices or returns.

repository_evidence.regulated_capital_boundary: Campaign181 freezes prudential capital, liquidity and solvency requirements and restoration. It does not identify loan books, classification migration, credit loss allowance, write-off, disposal or recovery flows.
repository_evidence.credit_facility_boundary: Campaign182 freezes the listed issuer as borrower, its facilities, covenants and liquidity backstops. The proposed domain observes a bank as lender and requires borrower-pool loan classification and resolution semantics.
repository_evidence.sector_boundary: Point-in-time bank and regulated-lender scope must be frozen; non-lenders and non-loan-bearing entities remain structurally not applicable and cannot be filled with zero.
repository_evidence.point_in_time_boundary: A latest non-performing-loan ratio or current loan book cannot be projected backward without classification-regime, formation, cure, restructuring, write-off, sale, recovery, correction and first-public histories.

finite_prevalue_catalog.name: loan_classification_migration_nonperforming_formation_cure_and_overdue_state
finite_prevalue_catalog.economic_state: A close-known bank loan-book state linking performing, special-mention, overdue, non-performing and impaired categories to migration, formation, cure, upgrade, downgrade and stock-flow reconciliation.
finite_prevalue_catalog.reason: No admitted point-in-time history freezes regulated entity, consolidation scope, loan population, classification regime, grade or stage migration, overdue days, formation, cure, correction and first-public timing across 2019-2023.

finite_prevalue_catalog.name: loan_loss_allowance_provision_charge_release_and_coverage_state
finite_prevalue_catalog.economic_state: A close-known credit-loss allowance state connecting opening and closing allowance, provision charge or release, expected or incurred loss stage, collateral and guarantee treatment, coverage denominator and regulatory overlays.
finite_prevalue_catalog.reason: The repository lacks a complete bank-specific allowance roll-forward with accounting and regulatory basis, gross exposure and accrued-interest denominator, stage transfer, collateral, overlay, write-back, restatement and trading-session availability.

finite_prevalue_catalog.name: nonperforming_loan_writeoff_bulk_transfer_securitization_and_recovery_state
finite_prevalue_catalog.economic_state: A close-known distressed-loan resolution state covering write-off, bulk sale, transfer, securitization, debt-to-equity conversion, collateral realization, cash recovery and residual servicing or recourse.
finite_prevalue_catalog.reason: No complete point-in-time source connects disposed exposure to resolution method, buyer or vehicle, gross and net carrying value, proceeds, retained risk, recourse, later recovery, reversal, correction and failed transactions.

finite_prevalue_catalog.name: loan_restructuring_forbearance_collateral_concentration_and_resolution_state
finite_prevalue_catalog.economic_state: A close-known loan-risk state covering restructuring and forbearance, maturity extension, interest concession, collateral and guarantee coverage, borrower concentration, default, enforcement and restoration to performing status.
finite_prevalue_catalog.reason: No admitted history preserves bank and borrower-pool identity, restructuring terms, regulatory forbearance, collateral and guarantee valuation, concentration, enforcement, cure criteria, repeated restructuring, correction and first-public availability.

finite_prevalue_catalog.name: generic_impairment_capital_liquidity_covenant_interest_pricing_or_security_price_relabeling
finite_prevalue_catalog.economic_state: An existing generic impairment, prudential capital or liquidity, borrower covenant, interest-price, accounting-profit or security-price state relabeled as bank loan asset quality.
finite_prevalue_catalog.reason: Those aggregate states do not identify the lender loan population, classification and migration regime, formation, cure, allowance denominator, write-off, transfer, recovery or forbearance lifecycle.

finite_prevalue_catalog.name: asset_quality_direction_threshold_classification_denominator_segment_window_or_subset_variant
finite_prevalue_catalog.economic_state: A direction, transform or subset of non-performing or special-mention ratio, formation, migration, provision coverage, write-off, recovery, restructuring, borrower segment, product, region or event window.
finite_prevalue_catalog.reason: Choosing higher or lower ratios, gross or net denominators, five-grade or three-stage mappings, successful recoveries only, industry or region subsets, lags or windows before source admission would multiply hypotheses and introduce survivorship.

finite_prevalue_catalog.name: combined_loan_migration_provision_resolution_and_forbearance_score_or_model
finite_prevalue_catalog.economic_state: A joint bank asset-quality score across loan classification migration, allowance coverage, distressed-loan resolution and restructuring or collateral states.
finite_prevalue_catalog.reason: Combining four unadmitted source families or choosing normalization, weights, interactions, filters, subsets or models would expand the search before bank scope and every base source contract are complete.

must_freeze_before_any_formula_or_direct: exact regulatory return, exchange filing, annual or interim report loan table, asset-management transaction record or licensed structured source with immutable bytes and stable issuer, regulated-entity, document, table, observation and transaction identifiers
classification date, reporting period, restructuring, default, cure, write-off, transfer, recovery, correction, first-public, supersession and trading-session availability timestamps

listed security, bank parent, regulated bank, branch, subsidiary, consolidated group, unconsolidated vehicle, asset-management company, buyer, servicer, borrower pool and counterparty mapping without current-state leakage
point-in-time bank and regulated-lender taxonomy with structural not-applicability for non-lenders and entities without an applicable loan book
performing, special-mention, overdue, non-performing five-grade, impaired and expected-credit-loss stage taxonomies with regime version and auditable crosswalks
gross loan, advances, accrued interest, off-balance-sheet commitment, purchased credit-impaired asset, net carrying amount and risk-exposure denominator semantics
opening stock, additions, formation, upgrade, downgrade, cure, restructuring, write-off, sale, transfer, securitization, recovery and closing stock reconciliation
specific, general, expected-credit-loss and regulatory allowance, provision charge, release, overlay and coverage-ratio numerator and denominator semantics
borrower industry, product, region, size, related-party, single-name and group concentration plus collateral, guarantee, seniority and valuation semantics without privacy-driven selection
forbearance, regulatory relief, repayment extension, interest concession, repeated restructuring, default, enforcement, collateral realization and return-to-performing criteria
consolidated and solo scope, gross and net presentation, unit, currency, translation, intra-group elimination, double counting, missing, undisclosed, not-applicable and true-zero semantics

complete bounded 2019-2023 partition manifest, full eligible-bank denominator, entity and security identifier history, delisting and merger coverage, identity, timing, regime, classification, roll-forward, resolution and source-acceptance tests using no factor, comparator, security-price or return values

scientific_interpretation.safe_conclusion: Four loan classification, provisioning, resolution and forbearance lifecycle states remain deferred at source admission; adjacent-domain relabeling, premature operator search and unadmitted combinations are closed before values.

next_action: Record both overlap rejections, both infrastructure failures and all seven bank asset-quality decisions in the Campaign187 hash chain, then publish terminal accounting without numeric comparison.
